resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, formula, unit, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The current-law heading used a Bokmål form of straum.
evidence: The previous title was Kirchhoffs strømlov.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk form Kirchhoffs straumlov.

findings.summary: The circuit node term was left as the English loanword node.
evidence: The previous bullet began Ein node.
findings.resolution: Used the clearer Nynorsk term knutepunkt.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used the Bokmål verb gir.
evidence: The previous wording used gir straumen.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk form gjev.

findings.summary: The current-law example used an awkward phrase for current leaving a branch.
evidence: The previous text said ei grein fører 3 A ut.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as 3 A går ut gjennom ei grein and clarified the remaining current.

findings.summary: The voltage example used a dot decimal despite the locale convention.
evidence: The previous formula began +8.0 V.
findings.resolution: Changed it to +8,0 V.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch annotation used a Bokmål form.
evidence: The previous annotation ended with parallellgrener.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk form parallellgreiner.

findings.summary: The cell-capacity sentence used an ungrammatical passive construction.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with om lag blir summert.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as kapasitet og straum blir om lag summerte.

findings.summary: The TCR description narrowed resistance to a conductor.
evidence: The previous description referred to motstanden i ein leiar.
findings.resolution: Used the broader and more accurate term komponent.

findings.summary: The positive-TCR bullet used an unexplained abbreviation as a noun.
evidence: The previous wording was Ein positiv TCR tyder.
findings.resolution: Expanded the term to Ein positiv temperaturkoeffisient.

findings.summary: The TCR limits paragraph used a possessive construction that was unnatural in Nynorsk.
evidence: The previous text began Produsenten sin TCR.
findings.resolution: Changed it to TCR-en til produsenten and named the first-order model clearly.

findings.summary: The opposite-side label used a Bokmål spelling.
evidence: The previous formula used motstående.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Nynorsk motståande.

findings.summary: The adjacent-side label used a Bokmål spelling.
evidence: The previous formula used hosliggende.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Nynorsk hosliggjande.

findings.summary: The angle-unit heading used the Bokmål form radianer.
evidence: The previous title was Grader og radianer.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Grader og radianar.

findings.summary: The radians formula left its unit in English.
evidence: The previous formula ended with radians.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit to radianar.

findings.summary: The degree/radian warning paragraph contained several Bokmål forms.
evidence: The previous paragraph used være, brukes, annet, and radianer.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph in consistent Nynorsk.

findings.summary: The waveform heading used Bokmål vocabulary.
evidence: The previous title was Bølgeformer og nyttige identiteter.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Bølgjeformer og nyttige identitetar.

findings.summary: The waveform variable definitions omitted Nynorsk inflections.
evidence: The previous bullet used amplitude and tid as bare Bokmål forms.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with amplituden and tida.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity heading was in Bokmål.
evidence: The previous title was Grunnleggende sammenhenger.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Grunnleggjande samanhengar.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference sentence used an inconsistent article.
evidence: The previous sentence began En temperaturforskjell.
findings.resolution: Used the consistent Nynorsk form Ein temperaturforskjell.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity setup mixed Bokmål forms vann and fra with Nynorsk text.
evidence: The previous setup used vann fra.
findings.resolution: Changed it to vatn frå.

findings.summary: The heating-time setup mixed Bokmål en with Nynorsk grammar.
evidence: The previous setup used med en konstant kilde.
findings.resolution: Changed it to med ei konstant kjelde.

findings.summary: The heating-time conclusion was written in Bokmål.
evidence: The previous text used tiden, omtrent, and sekunder without Nynorsk agreement.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with tida, om lag, and the correct feminine pronoun ho.

findings.summary: The object/material explanation mixed Bokmål vocabulary and syntax.
evidence: The previous paragraph used gjelder, avhenger, spesifikk, and til stede.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it in consistent Nynorsk and retained the mass relationship.

findings.summary: The practical-limits paragraph used Bokmål forms and a literal equation term.
evidence: The previous text used ligningen, antar, gjøre, and avviker.
findings.resolution: Changed it to likninga, føreset, gjere, and avvik in consistent Nynorsk.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name did not distinguish flux density from total heat flow.
evidence: The previous display name was Varmestrøm while q'' is defined per unit area.
findings.resolution: Changed the display name to Varmestrømtettleik.
